title: ExternalAgentLogRecord
description: One record in an imported external agent log file (.json array element or .jsonl line). Only timestamp and agentName are required - a foreign agent's log format is never assumed to match this platform's own. Unrecognized extra fields are allowed and preserved verbatim, not rejected.

timestamp.description: Any string parseable by JavaScript's Date constructor (ISO 8601 recommended, e.g. 2026-01-15T10:30:00Z).

userId.description: The external system's own user identifier, if available. Never assumed to correspond to this platform's internal user IDs - stored separately as externalUserId.

agentName.description: Name of the external agent that produced this record.

model.description: Optional - the model the external agent used, if reported.

inputTokens.description: Optional - the external system may not report token counts at all.

status.description: The external system's own status string, in whatever vocabulary it uses (e.g. 'ok', 'success', '200', 'failed', 'ERROR'). Normalized into a boolean isError by a documented heuristic - see docs/EXTERNAL_LOG_FORMAT.md.
